name: ISO/IEC 7816 HLA
description: High Level Analyzer for ISO/IEC 7816 smart card protocol. Requires the ISO/IEC-7816 Low Level Analyzer as input. Reconstructs ATR, PPS, T=0/T=1 TPDU and APDU frames from the char-level LLA output. Latest release: https://github.com/Lefix2/ISO7816Analyzer/releases/latest
author: Lefix2
